### T3. Exploration diagnostics (means over seeds)

"exploratory" = sentinel, epsilon, untried/reset arm, or a score choice outside the posterior-mean argmax among available arms. Yields are pooled (hits / probes). Myopic loss = sum over exploratory probes of [P(a mean-argmax arm would have hit now) − hit], hidden outcomes, analysis only. Posterior mean = the policy's own mean (novelty rate for C2/v0.6, violation rate for UCB1/D-UCB).
